CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

2. Which response best shows understanding of Jesus Passion, Death and Resurrection? (1 mark)
   A. Say Jesus Passion, Death and Resurrection has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Jesus Passion, Death and Resurrection with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Jesus Passion, Death and Resurrection to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Jesus Passion, Death and Resurrection.

3. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

4. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Study Methods Devotional Method? (1 mark)
   A. Say Bible Study Methods Devotional Method has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Bible Study Methods Devotional Method with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Bible Study Methods Devotional Method to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Study Methods Devotional Method.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Prophet Hosea? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prophet Hosea.
   B. Apply the teaching of Prophet Hosea with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Prophet Hosea to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Prophet Hosea has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Biblical Stewardship? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Biblical Stewardship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Biblical Stewardship.
   C. Say Biblical Stewardship has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Biblical Stewardship to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Schism and Syncretism in Israel? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Schism and Syncretism in Israel with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Schism and Syncretism in Israel to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Schism and Syncretism in Israel.
   D. Say Schism and Syncretism in Israel has no place in daily life.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Monarchy in Israel: King Solomon? (1 mark)
   A. Say Monarchy in Israel: King Solomon has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Monarchy in Israel: King Solomon to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Monarchy in Israel: King Solomon with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Monarchy in Israel: King Solomon.

9. Which response best shows understanding of General Epistle: James? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing General Epistle: James.
   B. Say General Epistle: James has no place in daily life.
   C. Use General Epistle: James to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of General Epistle: James with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem.
   C. Use Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem has no place in daily life.

11. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

12. Which response best shows understanding of Restoration of Judah: Nehemiah? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Restoration of Judah: Nehemiah.
   B. Use Restoration of Judah: Nehemiah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Restoration of Judah: Nehemiah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Restoration of Judah: Nehemiah has no place in daily life.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Monarchy in Israel: King David and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Monarchy in Israel: King Solomon and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Schism and Syncretism in Israel and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Restoration of Judah: Nehemiah and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. B — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

2. B — Apply the teaching of Jesus Passion, Death and Resurrection with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. B — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

4. B — Apply the teaching of Bible Study Methods Devotional Method with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. B — Apply the teaching of Prophet Hosea with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. A — Apply the teaching of Biblical Stewardship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. A — Apply the teaching of Schism and Syncretism in Israel with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. C — Apply the teaching of Monarchy in Israel: King Solomon with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. D — Apply the teaching of General Epistle: James with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. A — Apply the teaching of Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. D — Telling the truth and keeping trust

12. C — Apply the teaching of Restoration of Judah: Nehemiah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Monarchy in Israel: King David; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Monarchy in Israel: King Solomon; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Schism and Syncretism in Israel; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Restoration of Judah: Nehemiah; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
